item.description: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways ( MoRTH ) has amended Rule 115 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, to revise the validity periods of Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificates. The Central Motor Vehicles (Sixteenth Amendment) Rules, 2026, were notified on 13 November 2026 through G.S.R. item.content:encoded:
